description: This file defines a Lit controller class 'I18nController' that manages internationalization support by subscribing to an 'i18n' object and triggering UI updates on language changes.

classes.name: I18nController
classes.description: A Lit ReactiveController that integrates internationalization updates into a web component.

methods.name: constructor
methods.description: Initializes the controller with a host and registers it.

methods.name: hostConnected
methods.description: Sets up subscription to i18n changes and requests UI update.

methods.name: hostDisconnected
methods.description: Cleans up the subscription when the host is disconnected.
